title: Google I/O 2011: Kick-Ass Game Programming with Google Web Toolkit
summary: Google I/O 2011 session by Ray Cromwell and Philip Rogers on writing 2D and 3D games with HTML5 and GWT. It covers porting game libraries and physics engines, sharing code with Android, and publishing to the Chrome Web Store, and showcases the ForPlay library.
why: HN cites it as the original showing of ForPlay (later PlayN), the cross-platform Java game library.

quote.text: It was originally shown off as ForPlay at Google I/O '11.
